## What to remember {#revision-essentials}

- For a query at position i, keys at positions j ≤ i are accessible. The diagonal allows access to the current position.
- The mask blocks future-position scores before softmax, typically by setting them to negative infinity. Their weights are then zero.
- During parallel training, position i can see token i while predicting token i + 1, which its attention cannot access.
- This restriction makes it possible to compute the terms of the autoregressive factorization in parallel. Each term predicts the next token using only the available prefix.

## Recall from memory {#revision-check}

For A, B, C and D, which positions can C read and which token is its target in shifted training?

<details>
<summary>Show the answer</summary>

C can read A, B and C. The target is D. The position of D remains masked for C’s query.

</details>
